case_batching: one VCF batch per scenario; unique rsIDs within each batch
source_fidelity_observations: Candidate trace for every parsed case and returned source entry where a finding is expected. Failed-filter cases use the rejected candidate only; no-call cases are inapplicable.
batch_evidence_contract: Validate the production evidence schema and semantic references. Invalid document-local associations fail batch accounting and overall success; preserve validation errors locally and publish counts only.
applicability: Every frozen case remains in every check denominator except source_record_fidelity for the predefined no_call scenario. Missing or extra outputs are failures.
unit: Constructed case contracts; nine paired cases per source-record cluster. Not independent biological samples.
scope: Selected-record to minimal ClinVar database to production VCF parser, lookup and evidence export. No production TSV import, default report/ranking evaluation, other reference sources, model generation or clinical validation.
